name: com.siampiwat.indoormapsdk.presentation.view.stores.StoresActivity
description: When a user chooses a starting point or destination in the SmartSoft Asia Siam Piwat MappedIn indoor map, this Activity searches and lists mall stores and sets the selected store as the route origin or destination.
disableEffect: Users cannot search for or choose a store as a route endpoint, so indoor directions that use store selection stop working.
